name: Risk-on regime momentum — ride crypto trend only while the composite risk regime is switched on
rationale: MECHANISM: same conditioning thesis (trends persist when the deleveraging tail is off) expressed via the composite risk_on_off regime feature — a single derived read of whether the broad cross-asset risk appetite is switched ON. When risk_on_off is positive, allocators are adding risk and crypto momentum has a following wind; take crypto momentum longs (positive ret_Nd) only in that regime, and STAND ASIDE the moment the regime flips off. Distinct regime basis (composite risk_on_off) from the VIX/credit/NFCI variants. DISCONFIRMER: risk_on_off is a derived composite whose construction may already embed momentum-like inputs, so 'risk-on AND crypto trending' can be tautological — the gate may add ZERO information. Kill unless an ablation shows the regime gate lifts OOS net-of-fee Sharpe vs identical momentum with NO gate. Also kill if it is economically identical to another calm/loose-regime variant (hh-macro-17/19) — regime reads that collapse into one trade keep only the best. Expect a curve-fit death at the Gate if it merely trims trades.
catalyst: risk-on composite regime with crypto momentum
